primary_applicant: HPD - NYC Dept of Housing Preservation & Development
project_brief: HPD seeks approval of a UDAAP Designation, Project and Disposition (HA) and DCAS and NYPD for the Acquisition of city-owned property (PQ) for a replacement-in-kind of the NYPD parking lot. These actions would facilitate the development of a 19-story building, containing approximately 341 affordable housing units, located in East Harlem, Community District 11, Manhattan.
